objects.taxonomy_description: Fabric bag with two parallel shoulder straps for carrying on the back. The main compartment is a rectangular or rounded pouch (30-55 cm tall) made of nylon, canvas, or polyester with a zipper or drawstring closure. External features include side pockets, front organizer pockets, and compression straps. The back panel has padded shoulder straps that converge at the top and a reinforced grab handle. Materials range from smooth synthetic fabric to textured canvas. Colors vary widely. The bag exhibits bilateral symmetry with straps positioned symmetrically on the back panel.

objects.taxonomy_description: Domestic cat with a distinctive grey or tawny coat mottled with black in a tabby pattern. Coat features characteristic M-shaped marking on the forehead, dark stripes along the body, and ringed tail. Pattern types include classic (swirled), mackerel (striped), spotted, or ticked. Body is medium-sized, well-proportioned, and muscular. Head is round with a short muzzle. Ears are medium-sized, pointed, and erect. Eyes are large, round, and green, gold, or copper. The breed's signature features include the distinctive tabby pattern with M forehead marking and striped legs.

objects.taxonomy_description: Domestic swine measuring 90-180 cm body length weighing 50-350 kg. Body stocky and barrel-shaped with sparse coarse bristles over pink, black, or spotted skin. Head large with elongated snout ending in cartilaginous disk for rooting. Eyes small. Ears large and floppy or erect depending on breed. Legs short and stout with cloven hooves. Tail short and curly. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Omnivorous with highly developed olfactory sense.
